accepted_limits: The actual selected-node parser and listener remain untested.
REP=0 then EOF alone is explicitly recorded as connection closure, not route rejection; the log event must carry the rule oracle.
The saved mock config uses a fake socks5 loopback node and is structurally equivalent only in non-node fields; it is not a real-node run.
No positive gz02 PROXY route, SSH, graph, APK startup or device claim follows.
blocking_finding: The exact route event is the sole oracle for a real TEST-NET-3 MATCH/REJECT selection, but after a clean run run_instance deletes the credential-bearing raw debug log and exports only route_event_sha256 plus route_reject_proven=True. A postrun independent reviewer cannot recompute the event SHA or inspect its target/rule/action from the deleted raw stream. The mock event proves the parser can find a mock event, not that the real one occurred. Thus the candidate cannot deliver independently reviewable evidence for its stated v2b result.
required_fix: New frozen generation: while holding the private raw log, parse exactly one whole log event and export only a strict, credential-free normalized record (source=127.0.0.1 with ephemeral port, target=203.0.113.1:9, rule=Match, action=REJECT) with raw-matched-event SHA; whitelist field lengths/characters and reject extra event or ambiguity. Do not export the full debug log, node name, server or password. Add a fixture that a forged substring/generic log cannot produce the normalized event and that postrun can recompute its digest from the exported record. Preserve private raw log deletion only after process cleanup.
resolved_v1_findings: SOCKS5 parser now reads a complete reply, validates version/reserved/ATYP/address/port and requires REP=0, loopback bind shape, then EOF. Generic failure, truncated reply, malformed ATYP and data-after-reply fixtures reject.
Exact bundled Mihomo no-credential mock records complete REP=0 then EOF, plus one actual debug route event for 203.0.113.1:9 Match using REJECT; mock binary/config/policy/raw stream hashes match.

Generated real config retains exact gz02 /32 PROXY then MATCH REJECT rules; structured lsof PID/loopback listener, source/controller/leaf freshness, release/nonce and private process-group/credential cleanup gates remain.

Debug logs are held in private 0600 files and are not copied verbatim into TERMINAL; process uncertainty retains the private directory. Seatbelt is a native macOS process policy, not a container/image/namespace.
review_actions: Read-only candidate/fixture/raw mock and hash review only; no real proxy, credentials, SSH, device, container, namespace, Bridge or count change.
